entities.name: Dutch West India Company
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Dutch West India Company, a political institution in Guyana during European Exploration and Colonial Contest (1616–1700). Grew from Raleigh publishes 'Discoverie of Guiana' and Sir Walter Raleigh explores Guiana in search of El Dorado. Led to the emergence of Dutch Settlement and Colonial Foundations and West India Company.
